customers_say: Customers find the water purifier easy to install and appreciate its good taste, clean output, and great service. The reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some say it works well initially, others report it stops working after 4 months and won't last more than a year. The value for money and water wastage aspects also get mixed reviews, with some finding it worth the price while others consider it costly and question the zero-wastage claim.

reviews.author: CHRISTADIMA
reviews.title: Poor Product Quality and Unresolved Issue Despite 3 Service Visits”
reviews.body: Very disappointing product and service. The product has not been working properly since I purchased it. I have contacted customer service multiple times, and the technician has visited three times and carried out servicing, but the problem still continues. Despite repeated service visits, the issue has not been properly resolved. I expected much better quality and after-sales support from KENT. I would not recommend this product unless the company can fix the issue permanently.

reviews.title: Not capable for hard water
reviews.body: Such big brands not capable of handling hard water. The filter got crashed within a month. Thank god this was under warranty period and I was not charged.
